prayerExcerpt.en-US: "Prayer is life, not an oasis in the desert of life."
prayerExcerpt.pt-BR: "A oração é vida, não um oásis no deserto da vida."

meta.face: A Frisian of about sixty, clean-shaven, with a fair complexion and a LONG face that WIDENS at HIGH, broad cheekbones and narrows to a pointed chin — a high forehead under a thick, springy CREST of wavy grey hair brushed up and back, small, narrowed, smiling eyes with crinkles at the corners behind small ROUND steel-rimmed spectacles, a LONG nose with a slight bump and a rounded tip, lean cheeks folded by smile lines, a thin-lipped, gently smiling mouth; the head a little tilted, the gaze kind and humorous. Not maximilian_kolbe (beard, balding) nor josemaria_escriva (round face, dark rectangular glasses).
meta.basis: His photographs (Nationaal Archief, late 1920s, on Wikimedia Commons; the rector's portrait of 1932; the Dicastery's portrait): a long face widening at the cheekbones, a crest of thick wavy hair brushed up, small smiling eyes behind round steel spectacles, a long nose with a rounded tip and a thin, smiling mouth, in the Carmelite habit with the white cloak. The card makes him about sixty, as at his arrest in 1942.
meta.excerpt: His saying «La preghiera è vita, non un'oasi nel deserto della vita», as the Dicastery's biography gives it; our rendering (he died in 1942)
